summary: Phenazone (antipyrine) is used with a local anaesthetic (benzocaine or lidocaine) in ear drops for the pain of acute otitis media. Systemic phenazone is obsolete.
indications: Ear pain in acute otitis media (with intact eardrum)

dosage.d: Fill the ear canal (4 to 5 drops), plug with cotton; repeat every 1 to 2 hours as needed

admin: Use only as the finished product directs
moa: Analgesic and anti-inflammatory (pyrazolone); benzocaine provides local anaesthesia.
preg: Safety not established; use only if clearly needed
